items.title: Cognizant lifts annual profit forecast on strong financial services growth
items.summary: Cognizant Technology on Wednesday raised its annual adjusted profit forecast after recording ‌strong growth in its financial services business ‌and continued operating margin expansion in the second quarter, even as ​enterprises remained cautious about discretionary spending. Shares of the company were up 10%. Cognizant now expects adjusted profit per share for the year in the range of $5.70 ‌to $5.82, up from ⁠its prior forecast of $5.63 to $5.77.
